versions.changelog:
ClawHub 0.1.0 – Initial release

- Provides end-to-end encrypted messaging for AI agents using AES-256-GCM and public key cryptography.
- Supports agent identity creation and verification using unique cryptographic fingerprints and public key registration.
- Enables asynchronous and persistent message queues, including broadcast channels and priority messaging.
- Includes message signing for sender authenticity and ensures perfect forward secrecy on each message.
- Offers clear Python implementation guides for agent initialization, message encryption, and message signing.
